card_text: Speakers and amplifiers repaired at our Sukuldhoka shop. Bring it in.
title: Speaker and amplifier repair in Bhaktapur
intro: We repair speakers and amplifiers in-house at our shop in Sukuldhoka, Bhaktapur. Bring it to the shop and we'll check it.
how: Bring the speaker or amplifier to the shop in Sukuldhoka.
We check it and tell you the price before any work starts.
ask: Hi, speaker/amplifier repair bare sodhnu chha.
